parsed_json.up: Select distinct chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles for compounds linked to document CHEMBL4376833. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id filtering by chembl_id CHEMBL4376833. Inner join compound_structures on molregno to require canonical_smiles. Order by chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles.
